blocks.text: Admins can configure, edit, and delete agent groups as needed.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Agent Groups.
Click the Edit icon next to the agent group you want to edit.
The Edit Agent Group window appears. If you are editing an agent group with the Kubernetes Cluster type, the Edit Cluster window appears.
In the Edit Agent Group window, modify the information as necessary. To learn more, see Configuring Agent Groups.
If you change the Admin Status, you are asked if you also want to change the Admin Status for all agents in that group. To learn more, see Editing Agents.

blocks.text: Your updated agent group reflects the changes in the list of agent groups.
